draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Totally understandable -- thanks for letting me know you've been heads-down. No pressure at all on timing, and your bulk import question is wrapped up on our side (teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, whenever you're ready).

When you do get a window, the simplest starting point is a first project -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. If it's helpful, I'm happy to set up a short call this week and get that first project started with you so it's one less thing on your list.

Best,
Priya
